ValidationRule.description: Increased cap required to close case for project increase cap and delta to cap
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Project__c , "Increase Cap"), Not(ISPICKVAL( Increased_Cap__c , "No")), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Closed"), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Completed_Conversation_Exhausted__c, "Never Worked")), OR( ISBLANK( Sunday_Cap_Increase__c ), ISBLANK( Weekday_Cap_Increase__c ), ISBLANK( Saturday_Cap_Increase__c )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Amount Cap Increased fields (Saturday, Sunday, & Monday) are required to close this Case.
